author: Parsifal-2045
body:
This PR introduces the currently supported tracker geometries to be consumed by the updated BL fit introduced in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51915.
A map index file is also added to allow for automatic dispatching of the correct map depending on the configuration with a README detailing the dispatch mechanism and how to re-generate updated maps
title: Add binary versions of material maps consumed by the BL fit
